_note: Imported 3D models (GLB in public/). Each replaces the procedural shape of a gear base when it has loaded; the procedural shape stays as the fallback. Models are baked to the bone convention: grip at the origin, blade along +Z, 1 unit = 1 m. Characters are skinned bodies (skinned.js): armDrop lowers the T-pose arms to the rest pose (shoulderWiden moves the shoulder joints out and clavicleLift raises the collarbones, for square shoulders), headCentre/headScale and neckScale fit the procedural hair, face and scarf to the head. Monsters are skinned onto the procedural monster rigs (monsterSkin.js): scale/yaw align the model (feet on the ground), bones moves rig joints onto the model, segments are per-bone lines (aligned rest space, metres) that set the skin weights. rootScale enlarges the model's whole rig in the world.
